heuristic_c_note: src/daemon.c:9770-9781's persona reading-delay heuristic (base_sec*300ms + jitter, capped at 8000ms) models a different quantity at a different timescale (sub-8s typing pause, not the multi-second-to-hour notice-and-reply gap this model targets) and would not be a faithful comparison; see this script's docstring for the full reasoning.
caveats: contact frequency terciles computed over the full (train+test) window, not train-only — affects bucket selection only, not the fitted quantile values themselves

point predictions use each resolved bucket's p50 (median), not a random sample from the quantile table (that sampling behavior is what the C production loader uses for natural variance; a point predictor is the correct comparison for accuracy metrics)
